feature.title: Install Forgejo and Grafana from Keystone on iOS and macOS
feature.description: An operator uses either Keystone app to select Forgejo and Grafana, review the install plan for the target cluster, and install both services with the standard Grafana dashboards. Treat this as one delivery project across OS flake defaults, service charts, cluster reconciliation and both Apple clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh and existing configurations evaluate and keep services disabled until selected.
Pinned chart values render both services, storage and dashboards without embedded credentials.
A disposable cluster reports both endpoints ready, retains data across a reconcile, and can roll back.
Both clients submit the same selection, show cluster readiness, and retry without duplicating services.

bug.title: Preserve Grafana datasource placeholders during Charts dashboard install
bug.description: A dashboard with an unresolved datasource placeholder previews correctly. After local install, Keystone Charts drops the placeholder and renders an empty panel. Plan the fix for iOS and macOS using a synthetic manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: A regression fixture reproduces the placeholder loss at the preview-to-install transition.
Both apps preserve the placeholder until the local installation resolves it, or surface a useful validation error.
Install persists no partial dashboard on validation failure.
